summary: Attribute conversation follow re-opens and local replay-gap variants in exported trace spans

replay.detail: Instrumentation only. Conversation replay and recovery behavior are unchanged.

schema.detail: No schema, database, claim, generated-client or cursor-format change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or retention rule change.

compatibility.detail: No subscription frame, API error body, status, code, message or client-input change. Older clients continue to work.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart; no migration or replay.

manual.detail: No required manual step. With trace export enabled, each re-open emits one root span and each local replay gap emits another. Span volume follows the re-open rate; use high sampling for a bounded diagnostic window rather than continuously across an active fleet.

recovery.detail: Normal binary rollback; no persisted state change.
